Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: McCampbell
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/03/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 12 as introduced will decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund and local funds by a small, undetermined amount by exempting the Black Belt Regional Child Advocacy Center from paying state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes until September 30, 2026.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education

Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: McCampbell
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 04/05/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 12 as passed the House of Representatives will decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund and local funds by a small, undetermined amount by exempting the Black Belt Regional Child Advocacy Center from paying state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes until September 30, 2026.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
